Contiguous trade-block resampling is not computed because this normalized map uses retained complete window outcomes; trade-sequence timestamps remain source data rather than an imputed analysis table.
This overlay describes sensitivity. It is not a new confidence, support, quality, or archive gate.

leaveOneWindowOut.method: recompute the aggregate after removing each retained window once
leaveOneWindowOut.policyNote: the current four-window support policy is not redefined for three-window subsets

windowResampling.independenceAssumption: windows are treated as the unit of resampling; this is conservative relative to treating individual trades as IID but does not establish independence between overlapping market regimes
windowResampling.method: within-candidate resampling of complete retained windows with replacement
